eventMetadata.context_description: Duke Blue Devils' trader consensus heavily favored them as No. 1 East Region seed entering the Sweet 16 against No. 5 St. John's Red Storm, despite injury concerns for starters Caleb Foster (recent foot fracture surgery) and Patrick Ngongba (foot soreness), both of whom returned for the March 27 matchup at Capital One Arena. Foster's improbable second-half performance sparked a rally from a 55-45 halftime deficit to an 80-75 win, advancing Duke to their third straight Elite Eight. St. John's, coached by Rick Pitino with Big East Player of the Year Zuby Ejiofor's double-double, impressed via aggressive pressing but faltered late amid Duke's superior depth and 34-2 regular-season dominance.
